text: {"summary": "Cluster 'big' scores poorly on kubescape NSA (40.0) and MITRE (42.0). The most serious issue is the core/DaemonSet/agent: it runs privileged, mounts hostPath, and has a CRITICAL openssl CVE. The cluster-admin binding to system:masters looks like a platform default. The remaining failed controls are numerous low/medium \"synthetic\" items that I merged into one finding.", "targets": ["big"], "frameworks": [{"name": "NSA", "passed": 5, "failed": 45, "skipped": 5, "score": 40}, {"name": "MITRE", "passed": 6, "failed": 40, "skipped": 5, "score": 42}], "findings": [{"severity": "CRITICAL", "title": "Privileged container in DaemonSet agent", "resource": "core/DaemonSet/agent", "controls": ["C-0057", "Trivy PSS 3"], "evidence": "Kubescape C-0057 (CRITICAL, 2 resources, example core/DaemonSet/agent) and Trivy PSS control 3 Privileged Containers (2 fails) both flag privileged containers.", "fix": "kubectl -n core patch ds agent --type=json -p='[{\"op\":\"replace\",\"path\":\"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/securityContext/privileged\",\"value\":false}]'  # then add only the capabilities it needs"}, {"severity": "CRITICAL", "title": "Critical openssl CVE in agent image", "resource": "core/DaemonSet/agent", "controls": ["CVE-2025-90002"], "evidence": "Trivy reports CVE-2025-90002 (CRITICAL) in openssl 1.1.1 on core/DaemonSet/agent, fixed in 3.0.13. Combined with the privileged container this raises the risk of host compromise.", "fix": "Rebuild the agent image with openssl >= 3.0.13 and roll out the DaemonSet."}, {"severity": "HIGH", "title": "HostPath mount in DaemonSet agent", "resource": "core/DaemonSet/agent", "controls": ["C-0048"], "evidence": "Kubescape C-0048 (HIGH) fails on 2 resources, example core/DaemonSet/agent.", "fix": "Remove or narrow the hostPath volume, and mount it readOnly: true if it must stay. Use a PVC or projected volume where possible."}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "cluster-admin bound to system:masters group", "resource": "ClusterRoleBinding/cluster-admin", "controls": [], "evidence": "The rbac_and_argo data shows cluster-admin bound to Group:/system:masters. This looks like the Kubernetes default binding, and the digest shows no other admin subjects.", "fix": "No change if this is the default. Keep system:masters membership (certificates and kubeconfigs) tightly limited and use scoped RBAC for people."}, {"severity": "MEDIUM", "title": "Many failed Kubescape controls on app workloads (C-0300 to C-0339)", "resource": "app0..app39 Deployments (svc0..svc39)", "controls": ["C-0300", "C-0301", "C-0302", "C-0303", "C-0304", "C-0305", "C-0306", "C-0307", "C-0308", "C-0309", "C-0310", "C-0311", "C-0312", "C-0313", "C-0314", "C-0315", "C-0316", "C-0317", "C-0318", "C-0319", "C-0320", "C-0321", "C-0322", "C-0323", "C-0324", "C-0325", "C-0326", "C-0327", "C-0328", "C-0329", "C-0330", "C-0331", "C-0332", "C-0333", "C-0334", "C-0335", "C-0336", "C-0337", "C-0338", "C-0339"], "evidence": "40 controls named 'Synthetic control N' fail, rated LOW or MEDIUM and affecting 3 to 42 resources each. The digest gives no detail on what they check, so the fix is only generic.", "fix": "Review the controls in the kubescape report (kubescape scan control C-0301 -v) and apply the matching securityContext hardening."}], "not_checked": [{"item": "node and control-plane CIS checks", "reason": "need a privileged node-collector pod; the audit identity is read-only"}, {"item": "git history", "reason": "secrets removed from history are not scanned"}, {"item": "Details of the synthetic controls C-0300 to C-0339", "reason": "the digest gives only names, severities and counts, with no description of what they check"}, {"item": "Repos", "reason": "no repos were included in the digest"}]}
